symptom: D check passed by coincidence for TOKEN and failed for overlays: model damage from layout() was not drained before the item change

symptom: product bug: dirty.add(r) on an empty Rectangle(0,0,0,0) unions the origin, so every damage-only repaint re-rendered from (0,0) (overlays at the bottom-right exposed it)
correction: start the dirty region with setBounds(r) when empty, add() otherwise

symptom: product bug: accessibleName returned null for text-less items (pagination pages)
correction: fall back to the concept for the widget and to the 1-based number for items

symptom: product bug: blit and exposed strip assumed a vertical axis; horizontal segment strips damaged a row strip
correction: scrollsHorizontally() hook; strip along the axis; Control.scroll / copyArea along x

symptom: product bug: split arrow zone was the full height, which covers the whole button for tall ribbon buttons
correction: arrow zone = min(height, width / 3)

symptom: RTL check compared item 0 after the keys pass had scrolled the strip
correction: compare at scroll offset 0 on both sides of the RTL pass

symptom: product bug: scrollTo() re-projected the window but kept stale resident rects (paint and hit-test used old positions)
correction: arrange() = project + family layout + RTL mirror; scrollTo calls it, layout() calls it and damages all

symptom: product bug: the exposed strip and the blit ignored a fixed field above the scrolled list (autocomplete), so the blit would move the field too
correction: viewOrigin()/viewLength() public; strip offset by the origin; Control.scroll / copyArea limited to the viewport rect

symptom: check expected Alt+Down without focus to be unconsumed, but the shared navigation correctly moves focus to the first row
correction: assert that the order is unchanged instead

symptom: load check assumed no earlier load, but the keys pass had already reached the threshold at the same item count
correction: assert at most one load per item count and a fresh load after an add

symptom: product bugs: (1) closed pickers had viewLength 0, so scrolling never blitted; (2) Escape reported closing an always-open calendar; (3) cascader Right re-chose the same node and choose() trusted a stale path
correction: (1) the pop-up area is reserved inside the widget, rects only while open; (2) calendar Escape returns false; (3) choose() rebuilds the path from the parent lane and focuses the first child

symptom: check expected a closed calendar to ignore arrows; a calendar is always open
correction: exempt CALENDAR

symptom: product bug found by the Nebula/Swing differential (setLogicalCount step): text-less items threw NullPointerException in initials(), captcha noise and app-bar glyph lookup
correction: null-safe text in those three paths; core checks now paint two text-less items in every family

symptom: stricter probe picked nothing for most families: label boxes cover their whole item
correction: TEXT records cover only a conservative glyph box (0.8 em per char, 1.6 em high, by alignment)

symptom: screen capture on the hidden desktop came back white (blank frame) and a 24-step tolerance hid it (false PASS)
correction: tolerance 12; reject one-colour frames as BLANK_FRAME; Control.print evidence reported in its own columns

symptom: probe rejected every surface near the background colour (white cards on near-white bg), so 9 of 11 families had no probe
correction: accept them with tolerance 2 (exact interior fill); others 12

symptom: one-model law: the widgets re-implemented the resident window, extent, scroll bar and damage union
correction: per-side M3WebViewportCore binds SWT to the public M3 facades of eclipse.platform.swt PR #295 (VirtualViewportPlanner, VirtualScrollMetrics, ViewportLayerState, ViewportDamageRegion) and Swing to M3ViewportIndexWindow; models keep only the pixel-to-row mapping

symptom: product bug found by the pixel probe: a selection revealed before the first layout kept a stale scroll offset (navigation drew item 0 at y=-38)
correction: layout() clamps the scroll offset to the new logical extent

symptom: outline records (ROUND_LINE/OVAL_LINE) counted as covering their whole box, so bordered surfaces had no probe; one representative per family could have no fill
correction: outlines cover only an edge band; probes run every generated member and print a FAMILY verdict

symptom: TODO M3P-VIEWPORT-1: the Swing core kept its own extent, plane mask and damage union
correction: bind to new port API com.m3.swing.viewport.{M3ViewportExtent,M3ViewportPlanes,M3ViewportDamage} (contract of the SWT fork facades); the differential now also compares damage boxes and scroll bar thumbs

symptom: coverage stopped at 98.39% line / 93.11% branch (Swing) and the Nebula canvas classes had no test: model branches of modes no generated member uses (EDGE_END, LINK on Nebula) and combined key/modifier/RTL/open states were never driven
correction: TOP sweep (every key and char x 5 modifier sets x LTR/RTL x open/closed x both ends, pointer grid, empty model; invariants only), lane/view edges, id checks, crafted pixel-probe lists, MODES constant per family + everyMode and per-existing-member tests on both sides, edges() per family checks

symptom: product bug found by the sweep: Page Up/Down on an empty model called setFocus(0) (IndexOutOfBoundsException)
correction: page keys only with items

symptom: product bug found by the sweep: Down on an empty split button focused item 0 (IndexOutOfBoundsException)
correction: setFocus(Math.min(1, count - 1)); load() always adds an item so the SPLIT guard drops its count test

symptom: product bug found by the sweep: OTP backspace with no cells wrote cell 0 (IndexOutOfBoundsException)
correction: clearCell() returns on no cells; caretKey()/highlight() own their mode guards (no constant-true operands); revealPosition() replaces the nested ternary

symptom: product bug found by the edge checks: localisation keys were copied once, so items added, removed or rewritten after the first localize() were translated from stale keys
correction: the keys lane follows add/remove/setText/grow and clear() drops it
evidence: M3WebChecks.edges/ids on tag-input and every INPUT mode

symptom: product bugs: setLogicalCount() below the current count threw IllegalArgumentException (Arrays.fill from > to); new logical items kept stale lanes; remove() left focus on a different item and stale hover/press ids (a release after removing the pressed item threw)
correction: blank(from, to) empties new ids; setLogicalCount clamps focus/hover/press; remove() shifts ids above the removed item and drops hover/press of it; the now-dead id < count guards in setFocus/paint/setHover/TOKEN advance are removed
evidence: Swing component frames on pickers (5300 weeks -> 1000), M3WebChecks.ids

symptom: product bug found by the SWT canvas contract on the hidden desktop: layout() damages the whole area without a delta, so after Resize/computeSize/setBounds/getPreferredSize the next item change redrew the whole widget (D aspect violated)
correction: layoutTo(w, h) lays out and drops the full-area damage (the toolkit repaints a resize; a size query restores the layout); the canvas records lastRedraw for the contract
evidence: M3WebCanvasChecks.damageOnly: redraw request and Paint bounds equal the item rect

symptom: accessibility listeners were anonymous (untestable); polyline points allocated per record (TODO M3P-CORE-1)
correction: names/roles listener fields (package-visible); reusable point scratch reallocated only when the point count changes

symptom: changed() was 30 lines; the blit condition tested dirtyAll although a painted body is never dirtyAll; tick() unreachable from the contract
correction: blit(dy) extracted; condition dy != 0 && body != null; tick() package-visible
evidence: Swing component edges(): processKeyEvent/processFocusEvent direct, unpainted component, font cache growth

symptom: focusFirst() always returned true (constant operand of ||)
correction: focusFirst() is void; a trapped Tab that cannot move wraps explicitly

symptom: family checks assumed member samples: escape-without-menu assumed count > 1, OTP digits assumed two or more cells

symptom: a concept named switch produced a test method switch() (keyword)
